scope: Two Korean official historical tables. One document is searched per query. The gold answer is the listed paragraph containing the requested value, contradictory value, definition or time basis.

scoring.positive: Hit@1 and Hit@3 count a query once if a returned candidate paragraph is in gold. Header or neighbouring context does not count as a data row. A counterexample with the correct date and scope counts even when the number in the query is wrong.
scoring.control: Report separately how many queries with no answer in the excerpt returned at least one candidate. A candidate is not an automated verdict.
scoring.paragraphs: 1-based non-empty lines in the source excerpt, in the given order. Whitespace within cells is normalized and a tab separates table cells. Dates, numeric formatting and source row order are retained.
